t: Look up and you'll see The Brixton Heron, a sculptural wind-vane made in 2010 by Maggi Hambling. Hambling is a British artist, mainly a painter, whose best-known public works are A Conversation with Oscar Wilde, A Sculpture for Mary Wollstonecraft, and the steel Scallop on Aldeburgh beach. All three have attracted controversy. The Heron is a lighter piece, a weathervane that turns to show which way the wind is blowing over Brixton.
